stories.title: Account Linking Initiation & OTP Verification
stories.user_story: As Clara (loyalty customer), I want to link my separate online and in-store accounts by verifying ownership via OTP, so that my points are consolidated into a single account
acceptance_criteria: Given Clara is on the Profile screen, When she taps 'Link Accounts', Then a form is displayed requesting the email or phone number of the secondary account
Given Clara enters a valid email/phone of an existing account, When she submits, Then an OTP is sent to that email/phone and she is navigated to the OTP entry screen within 5 seconds
Given Clara enters the correct OTP within 5 minutes, When she submits, Then the system initiates the account merge process and displays a progress indicator
Given the 'Link Accounts' button, When navigated via VoiceOver/TalkBack, Then it is announced with its label and purpose ('Link another loyalty account to combine your points')
Given Clara enters an email/phone not associated with any account, When she submits, Then she sees an error: 'No account found with this email/phone. Please check and try again.'

requirements_used: FR-08 — Account Linking — verify ownership via OTP, consolidate points within 1 minute

stories.reasoning: 5 points due to OTP flow complexity, secondary account lookup, and validation logic. Accessibility AC required for user-facing screen. Security AC implicit via OTP verification preventing unauthorized linking. Confidential because it involves PII (email/phone) of another account.

stories.title: Account Merge Execution & Balance Consolidation
stories.user_story: As Clara (loyalty customer), I want my points balances, transaction histories, and tier status merged atomically when I link accounts, so that I don't lose any points or history
acceptance_criteria: Given OTP verification succeeds, When the merge executes, Then both accounts' points balances are summed and the combined balance is reflected on Clara's primary account within 1 minute
Given both accounts have transaction histories, When the merge completes, Then all transactions from both accounts appear in a single chronological history on the primary account
Given the secondary account has a higher tier than the primary, When the merge completes, Then the primary account retains the higher tier
Given the merge completes successfully, When Clara views her dashboard, Then she sees a notification: 'Accounts linked! Your combined balance is {total} points.'

requirements_used: FR-08 — Account Linking — consolidate points within 1 minute, merge transaction history

stories.reasoning: 8 points: atomic database merge of ledger entries, tier resolution, notification preferences consolidation, and audit logging. This is the most complex single operation in the system — must be transactional to prevent partial merges (NFR-08).

stories.title: Account Linking — Negative Paths & Edge Cases
stories.user_story: As Clara (loyalty customer), I want the system to prevent account linking when unsafe conditions exist, so that I don't encounter data corruption or unauthorized merges
acceptance_criteria: Given the secondary account has an active redemption in progress, When Clara attempts to link, Then the system blocks the merge and displays: 'The other account has a pending transaction. Please try again after it completes.'
Given the secondary account has a negative balance from returns, When the merge executes, Then the negative balance is carried forward and offset against the primary account's balance
Given Clara has already linked an account previously, When she attempts to link the same secondary account again, Then the system rejects with: 'This account has already been merged.'
Given the OTP has expired (after 5 minutes), When Clara enters it, Then she sees: 'Code expired. Please request a new one.' and can resend

requirements_used: FR-08 — Account Linking — verify ownership via OTP, consolidate points within 1 minute

stories.reasoning: 5 points: multiple edge cases requiring distinct validation logic. Negative balance carry-forward is a financial integrity concern. Blocking during active redemption prevents race conditions. This is the required negative-path story for F-07.1.

stories.title: Points Expiration Warning Notifications
stories.user_story: As Nathan (loyalty customer), I want to receive warning notifications before my points expire, so that I have time to make a purchase or redemption to keep them
acceptance_criteria: Given Nathan has been inactive for 11 months (30 days before expiration threshold), When the daily expiration job runs, Then he receives a push notification: 'Your {points} points will expire on {date} if you don't make a purchase or redemption.'

Given Nathan has been inactive for 11 months and 23 days (7 days before expiration), When the daily expiration job runs, Then he receives an urgent notification: 'Last chance! {points} points expiring in 7 days.'
Given Nathan makes a purchase after receiving the 30-day warning, When the earn transaction is processed, Then his inactivity timer resets and no further expiration warnings are sent
Given Nathan has push notifications disabled, When an expiration warning is triggered, Then it falls back to email delivery

requirements_used: FR-22 — Points Expiration Policy — 30-day and 7-day warnings, configurable inactivity period

stories.reasoning: 5 points: daily batch job logic, inactivity calculation, two-stage notification triggers, and activity reset logic. Confidential because notifications contain points balance. Timer reset on activity is critical to prevent false expirations.

stories.title: Points Expiration Execution
stories.user_story: As a Platform Engineer, I want a daily batch job that expires points for inactive customers after the configured threshold, so that the loyalty program liability is managed per business rules
acceptance_criteria: Given Nathan has been inactive for 12 months (configurable threshold), When the daily expiration job runs on the expiration date, Then a ledger entry is created: {type: 'expired', points: -balance} and his balance is set to 0
Given points are expired, When Nathan views his transaction history, Then the expiration entry is visible with an 'expired' badge and reason: 'Expired due to 12 months of inactivity'
Given the admin has configured expiration_months to 0 (never expire), When the daily job runs, Then no customers' points are expired regardless of inactivity period
Given Nathan's points are expired, When he receives the notification, Then it reads: 'Your {points} points have expired due to 12 months of inactivity. Make a purchase to start earning again!'

requirements_used: FR-22 — Points Expiration Policy — deduct and log expired points, configurable inactivity period
architecture_kb_sections: enterprise-architecture §3.2 (Cloud SQL PostgreSQL for transactional data)

stories.reasoning: 5 points: batch processing logic, ledger entry creation, balance zeroing, configurable threshold from admin, and notification dispatch. Depends on US-093 because warnings must be sent before expiration executes.

stories.title: Points Expiration — Negative Paths
stories.user_story: As Nathan (loyalty customer), I want the expiration system to handle edge cases correctly, so that my points are not unfairly expired
acceptance_criteria: Given Nathan has a pending redemption at the time of expiration, When the daily job runs, Then his points are NOT expired and the job retries the Dunelm day after the redemption completes

Given Nathan's account was merged (via account linking) within the inactivity period, When the expiration job evaluates his account, Then the inactivity timer uses the most recent activity from either merged account
Given the expiration batch job fails mid-execution, When it is retried, Then it resumes from where it left off without double-expiring any customer's points (idempotent)

requirements_used: FR-22 — Points Expiration Policy — configurable inactivity period, deduct and log expired points

stories.reasoning: 3 points: edge case handling for concurrent operations and idempotency. Pending redemption blocking prevents data inconsistency. Merged account activity consideration ensures fairness. This is the required negative-path story for F-07.2.

stories.title: Badge Definition & Award Engine
stories.user_story: As a Platform Engineer, I want a configurable badge engine that automatically awards badges when customers hit milestones, so that gamification runs without manual intervention
acceptance_criteria: Given a badge 'First Purchase' is configured with trigger_type: 'transaction_count' and trigger_value: 1, When Clara completes her first earn transaction, Then the badge is awarded to her profile
Given Clara already has the 'First Purchase' badge, When she makes another purchase, Then the badge is NOT awarded again (one-time only per badge per customer)
Given a new badge is created via admin, When the badge engine evaluates on the Dunelm transaction, Then it checks the new badge's trigger against all qualifying customers
Given the badge award succeeds, When the event is processed, Then a push notification is sent: 'Badge unlocked: {name}! {description}' with the badge icon

requirements_used: FR-13 — Gamification Badges — configurable milestones, displayed on profile

stories.reasoning: 5 points: trigger evaluation engine, multiple trigger types (points_threshold, transaction_count, event), deduplication logic, and notification integration. Public data sensitivity because badges contain no PII.

stories.title: Badge Display on Customer Profile
stories.user_story: As Clara (loyalty customer), I want to see my earned badges and locked badges with progress on my profile, so that I feel motivated to unlock more
acceptance_criteria: Given Clara has earned 3 badges, When she navigates to 'My Badges' section on her profile, Then earned badges are displayed in full color with name, icon, and date earned
Given there are badges Clara hasn't earned yet, When she views the badges grid, Then locked badges appear greyed out with a progress indicator (e.g., '7/10 purchases')
Given the badges grid, When navigated via screen reader, Then each badge is announced with: name, earned/locked status, and progress if locked
Given Clara is on a 320px mobile viewport, When the badges grid renders, Then it reflows to a 2-column layout without horizontal scrolling

requirements_used: FR-13 — Gamification Badges — displayed on profile
architecture_kb_sections: enterprise-architecture §9 (shared design system component library, WCAG 2.1 AA)

stories.reasoning: 3 points: UI grid component, earned/locked states, progress calculation, and responsive layout. Accessibility AC required for user-facing screen. Depends on US-096 because badges must be awardable before they can be displayed.

stories.title: Default Badge Set Configuration
stories.user_story: As a Platform Engineer, I want the system seeded with a default set of badges covering key milestones, so that gamification is active from launch without manual setup
acceptance_criteria: Given the system is deployed, When the badge seed script runs, Then the following badges exist: 'First Purchase' (1 earn), 'Century Club' (100 points), 'Points Master' (1000 points), 'Loyal Regular' (10 purchases), 'Redeemer' (1 redemption), 'App Pioneer' (app sign-up event), 'Linked Up' (account linked event)
Given each badge, When viewed in admin, Then it has: name, icon_url, description, trigger_type, trigger_value, and rarity (common/rare/epic) configured
Given the seed script has already run, When it runs again, Then it does not create duplicate badges (idempotent)
stories.reasoning: 2 points: seed data script with idempotency check. Low complexity but necessary for launch readiness. Depends on US-096 because the badge schema must exist before seeding.

stories.title: Badge Notification & Celebration UX
stories.user_story: As Clara (loyalty customer), I want a celebratory experience when I unlock a badge, so that I feel rewarded and motivated to earn more
acceptance_criteria: Given Clara unlocks a badge, When she Dunelm opens the app, Then a celebration modal appears with the badge icon, name, description, and a confetti animation
Given the celebration modal is displayed, When Clara taps 'View All Badges' or dismisses, Then she is navigated to the badges grid or the modal closes respectively

Given the celebration modal, When navigated via screen reader, Then the badge name and description are announced, and the modal is dismissible via Escape key with focus returned to the trigger element

requirements_used: FR-13 — Gamification Badges — configurable milestones, displayed on profile
architecture_kb_sections: enterprise-architecture §9 (shared design system component library, WCAG 2.1 AA)

stories.reasoning: 2 points: modal component with animation and accessibility. Celebration UX drives engagement and makes badges feel rewarding. Accessibility AC ensures screen reader users get equivalent experience.

stories.title: Gamification Badges — Negative Paths
stories.user_story: As Clara (loyalty customer), I want the badge system to handle edge cases gracefully, so that I don't receive incorrect badges or miss earned ones
acceptance_criteria: Given Clara's points are reversed due to a return, When her lifetime points drop below a badge threshold she previously crossed, Then the badge is NOT revoked (badges are permanent once earned)

Given the badge engine encounters an error while evaluating Clara's transaction, When the error occurs, Then the transaction still completes successfully and badge evaluation is retried asynchronously
Given Clara links two accounts where both had earned the same badge, When the merge completes, Then the badge appears only once on the merged profile with the earliest earned date
stories.reasoning: 3 points: edge case handling for reversals, error resilience, and merge deduplication. Badges being permanent once earned is a deliberate design choice to maintain trust. This is the required negative-path story for F-07.3.

stories.title: Expiration Dashboard Indicator & History Display
stories.user_story: As Nathan (loyalty customer), I want to see upcoming expiration dates and expired points in my dashboard and history, so that I'm always aware of my points status
acceptance_criteria: Given Nathan has points approaching expiration (within 30 days), When he views his dashboard, Then a warning banner is displayed: 'Your points expire on {date} — make a purchase to keep them!'
Given Nathan's points have expired, When he views his transaction history, Then the expiration entry shows with an 'Expired' badge, the points amount in red, and the reason
Given the expiration warning banner, When navigated via screen reader, Then it is announced as an alert with the expiration date and action suggestion

requirements_used: FR-22 — Points Expiration Policy — 30-day and 7-day warnings
architecture_kb_sections: enterprise-architecture §9 (shared design system component library, WCAG 2.1 AA)

stories.reasoning: 3 points: dashboard banner component, history entry styling, and accessibility. Provides in-app visibility complementing push notifications. Accessibility AC required for user-facing warning.

stories.title: Account Linking Audit Trail & Security Logging
stories.user_story: As a Platform Engineer, I want all account linking operations fully logged in the audit trail, so that merges can be investigated and reversed if needed
acceptance_criteria: Given an account merge completes, When the audit log is written, Then it contains: initiator_customer_id, secondary_customer_id, before_state (both accounts' balances, tiers, transaction counts), after_state (merged account state), timestamp, and correlation_id

Given an account linking attempt fails (OTP expired, blocked by active redemption), When the failure occurs, Then it is logged with: reason, initiator_id, target_email_hash (not plaintext), and timestamp

Given a security review is needed, When an admin queries the audit API with customer_id and action='account_linked', Then all linking events for that customer are returned with full before/after state

requirements_used: FR-28 — System Audit Trail — all state changes logged with actor, timestamp, action, before/after

stories.reasoning: 3 points: structured audit logging with before/after snapshots. Restricted data sensitivity because audit logs contain full account state including PII references. Security AC: target email is hashed in failure logs to prevent PII leakage in audit queries.

regression_summary.recommendation: Greenfield — no regression testing needed. All stories are new capabilities.
